newsitem.title: IRAN: Iranian industrial exports up 33 percent - minister.
newsitem.headline: Iranian industrial exports up 33 percent - minister.

text.p: Iran's exports of industrial goods rose 33 percent in the first nine months of the current Iranian year, Industry Minister Mohammad Reza Nematzadeh was on Wednesday quoted as saying.

"Statistics...show a significant growth in the nation's exports of industrial goods...the country has made made a significant stride in industry," Nematzadeh told the English- language daily Iran newspaper.
Industrial goods also accounted for 33 percent of Iran's total non-oil exports and between eight to nine percent of total exports, he said.
